title: RealLifeBounty
description: This Plugin Add Real Life Bounty System
body:
**RealLifeBounty**

A simple & powerful bounty-reward plugin for Minecraft servers.
Automatically reward players with money when they eliminate a target — fully powered by Vault.

**✅ Features**

- Automatic bounty reward on player kill
- 
- Fully customizable reward amounts
- 
- Vault economy support
- 
- Lightweight & optimized (0 lag)
- 
- In-game reload command
- 
- Custom prefix, messages & colors
- 
- Beginner-friendly configuration
- 

**🛠️ Commands**

Command	Description

/bounty reload	Reloads the configuration


**📦 Dependencies**

This plugin requires:

- [Vault](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/vault) (Economy API)


**Compatible With:**

- Paper 1.19.4
  
- Spigot 1.19.4
  
- Bukkit 1.19.4


**⚙️ Configuration (config.yml)**


```
reward-money: 100
prefix: "&a[Bounty] "
reward-message: "&aYou killed %player% and earned %money%!"
```

**❤️ Support**

Need help or want custom features?
Message me anytime on Modrinth or Discord!
